title: Storage on a phone: a PDF now opens in the phone's own viewer, with every page
text: On an iPhone (in Chrome, Safari or any other browser), opening a PDF from Storage showed only the first page, zoomed in and cut off, and you could not scroll to the other pages. Now, on a phone, the preview shows an Open PDF button. Tap it and the PDF opens in the phone's own viewer with every page, a page counter and pinch to zoom. Use Back to return to Storage. On a computer nothing changes: the PDF still shows inside the window. This fixes the Storage window only; PDFs opened from other places (a contact's documents, a company's signed contracts and similar) will follow.
points: On your phone: Storage → open a company → open a PDF → tap Open PDF
Scroll through all the pages and pinch to zoom; tap Back to come back to Storage
On a computer the PDF opens inside the Storage window as before
